arxiv-2106-04043.title: Dilated Convolution based CSI Feedback Compression for Massive MIMO Systems
arxiv-2106-04043.creator: Shunpu Tang, Junjuan Xia, Lisheng Fan, Xianfu Lei, Wei Xu, Arumugam Nallanathan
arxiv-2106-04043.description: Abstract Although the frequency-division duplex (FDD) massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system can offer high spectral and energy efficiency, it requires to feedback the downlink channel state information (CSI) from users to the base station (BS), in order to fulfill the precoding design at the BS.

arxiv-2110-05719.title: Dealing with Disagreements: Looking Beyond the Majority Vote in Subjective Annotations
arxiv-2110-05719.creator: Aida Mostafazadeh Davani, Mark Díaz, Vinodkumar Prabhakaran
arxiv-2110-05719.description: Abstract Majority voting and averaging are common approaches employed to resolve annotator disagreements and derive single ground truth labels from multiple annotations. However, annotators may systematically disagree with one another, often reflecting their individual biases and values, especially in the case of subjective tasks such as detecting affect, aggression, and hate speech.

arxiv-2301-09827.title: On multiplicative spectral sequences for nerves and the free loop spaces
arxiv-2301-09827.creator: Katsuhiko KURIBAYASHI
arxiv-2301-09827.description: Abstract . We construct a multiplicative spectral sequence converging to the cohomology algebra of the diagonal complex of a bisimplicial set with coefficients in a field. The construction provides a spectral sequence converging to the cohomology algebra of the classifying space of a category internal to the category of topological spaces.

arxiv-2304-00999.title: Bandits for Sponsored Search Auctions under Unknown Valuation Model: Case Study in E-Commerce Advertising
arxiv-2304-00999.creator: Danil Provodin (✉), Jérémie Joudioux, Eduard Duryev
arxiv-2304-00999.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Danil Provodin (✉), Jérémie Joudioux, Eduard Duryev. This paper presents a bidding system for sponsored search auctions under an unknown valuation model. This formulation assumes that the bidder’s value is unknown, evolving arbitrarily, and observed only upon winning an auction. Unlike previous studies, we do not impose any assumptions on the nature of feedback and consider the problem of bidding in sponsored search auctions in its full generality.

arxiv-2311-07567.title: Higher Chow groups and not necessarily admissible cycles Thanks: This paper is an output of a research project implemented as part of the Basic Research Program at the National Research University Higher School of Economics (HSE University). This paper was also supported in part by the contest ”Youn
arxiv-2311-07567.creator: Vasily Bolbachan
arxiv-2311-07567.description: Abstract . We construct some analog of cubical Bloch’s higher Chow groups. Instead of considering cycles in X × 𝔸 n X\times\mathbb{A}^{n} we consider varieties Y Y over X X together with a distinguished element in the n n -th exterior power of the multiplicative group of the field of fraction on Y Y .

arxiv-2312-10843.title: High-Fidelity Face Swapping with Style Blending
arxiv-2312-10843.creator: Xinyu Yang Hongbo Bo
arxiv-2312-10843.description: Abstract Face swapping has gained significant traction, driven by the plethora of human face synthesis facilitated by deep learning methods. However, previous face swapping methods that used generative adversarial networks (GANs) as backbones have faced challenges such as inconsistency in blending, distortions, artifacts, and issues with training stability.

arxiv-2402-08617.title: Demystifying Quantum Power Flow: Unveiling the Limits of Practical Quantum Advantage
arxiv-2402-08617.creator: Parikshit Pareek, Abhijith Jayakumar, Carleton Coffrin, and Sidhant Misra
arxiv-2402-08617.description: Abstract Quantum computers hold promise for solving problems intractable for classical computers, especially those with high time and/or space complexity. The reduction of the power flow (PF) problem into a linear system of equations, allows formulation of quantum power flow algorithms, based on quantum linear system solving methods such as the Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd (HHL) algorithm.

arxiv-2403-13843.title: Machine Learning and Transformers for Thyroid Carcinoma Diagnosis
arxiv-2403-13843.creator: Yassine Habchi, Hamza Kheddar, Yassine Himeur, Mohamed Chahine Ghanem
arxiv-2403-13843.description: Abstract The growing interest in developing smart diagnostic systems to help medical experts process extensive data for treating incurable diseases has been notable. In particular, the challenge of identifying thyroid cancer (TC) has seen progress with the use of machine learning (ML) and big data analysis, incorporating Transformers to evaluate TC prognosis and determine the risk of malignancy in individuals.

arxiv-2405-20036.title: Chirp asymmetry in Zeeman electromagnetically induced transparency
arxiv-2405-20036.creator: Joseph Gorkos, Karsten Grenzig, Erfan Nasirzadeh Orang, Victoria Thomas, Declan Tighe, Michael Crescimanno
arxiv-2405-20036.description: Abstract The simplest three-level system exhibiting electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) exhibits an effective conjugation symmetry as well as a permutation symmetry. Breaking conjugation symmetry leads to a distinct chirp asymmetry, i.e. the differential response to a frequency increase versus a frequency decrease.

arxiv-2408-04527.title: Charmed hypernuclei within density-dependent relativistic mean-field theory
arxiv-2408-04527.creator: Wei Yang, Shi Yuan Ding, Bao Yuan Sun
arxiv-2408-04527.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Wei Yang, Shi Yuan Ding, Bao Yuan Sun. arxiv-2410-01578.title: QCD field-strength correlators on a Polyakov loop with gradient flow at next-to-leading order
arxiv-2410-01578.creator: David de la Cruz, Alexander M. Eller, Guy D. Moore
arxiv-2410-01578.description: Abstract Momentum exchange between a heavy quark and a hot quark-gluon medium can be characterized nonperturbatively in terms of field-strength field-strength ( E − E E-E and B − B B-B ) correlators along a Polyakov loop. These can be studied on the lattice and analytically continued. However the lattice typically determines the correlators after the application of gradient flow.

pmc-11600616.title: The protumorigenic enzyme GPAT2 inhibits arachidonic acid-triggered apoptosis in breast cancer
pmc-11600616.creator: Fiorella J Ferremi, Veronica V Moscoso, Mauro A Montanaro, Maria R Gonzalez-Baro, Elizabeth R Cattaneo
pmc-11600616.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundCancer is a significant health challenge and the leading cause of mortality globally. Tumor cells use multiple mechanisms to acquire their distinctive capacity for uncontrolled proliferation, one of which is the evasion of apoptosis. It has been shown that in breast, colon, and liver cancer, evasion of apoptosis is associated with the overexpression of enzymes that metabolize arachidonic acid (AA) because free AA is a strong inducer of apoptosis.

pmc-12609209.title: Impact of Baseline Atrial Fibrillation on Conduction Disturbances After TAVR: Insights from a Large Cohort Study
pmc-12609209.creator: Ziad Arow, Omar Oliva, Laurent Bonfils, Laurent Lepage, Hana Vaknin-Assa, Abid Assali, Didier Tchetche, Nicolas Dumonteil
pmc-12609209.description: Background: Pre-existing atrial fibrillation (AF) is common among patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR). However, evidence regarding its impact on the risk of permanent pacemaker (PPM) implantation and other conduction disturbances (CDs) after TAVR remains inconsistent. The aim of this study was to assess the effect of baseline heart rhythm on the risk of conduction abnormalities following TAVR.

pmc-12693398.title: Ethosome-Based Colloidal Systems for Transdermal Delivery: The Role of Biosurfactant in Enhancing Stability and Efficacy
pmc-12693398.creator: Jagoda Chudzińska-Skorupinska, Agata Wawrzyńczak, Agnieszka Feliczak-Guzik
pmc-12693398.description: The effectiveness of transdermal drug delivery is restricted by the barrier properties of the stratum corneum. Ethosomes, as vesicular carriers, offer a promising approach to enhance dermal bioavailability. This study aimed to optimize ethosome composition and preparation parameters to improve physicochemical stability and performance.

pmc-13202793.title: Analyzing governance of a sub-national health insurance scheme for providing universal health care and better social health protection performance through the lenses of the principal-agent theory in Anambra state
pmc-13202793.creator: Uchenna Ezenwaka, Simeon Onyemaechi
pmc-13202793.description: BackgroundHealth system governance plays a crucial role in the performance of health reforms. In Nigeria, recent reforms like the decentralization of social health insurance to sub-national levels, aimed at improving access to services and financial risk protection, established Anambra State Health Insurance Scheme (ASHIS).

pmc-13282595.title: The Impact of Sunlight and Artificial Light at Night on Sleep Stages: Evidence From a 7-Day Sensor-Based Observational Study
pmc-13282595.creator: Andrea Montanari, Li Min Wang, Amit Birenboim, Basile Chaix
pmc-13282595.description: BackgroundExposure to circadian entrainers, such as sunlight, positively impacts sleep architecture, while exposure before bedtime to circadian disruptors, such as artificial light and smartphone use, can negatively affect sleep. However, real-world evidence from longitudinal observational studies that simultaneously capture these factors alongside electroencephalography-derived sleep stages remains limited.

pmc-13415100.creator: Iulia Gallo, Camelia Epuran, Ion Fratilescu, Raul Ștefan-Pantiș, Alexandru Pahomi, Mihaela Maria Budiul, Titus Vlase, Gabriela Vlase

pmc-13457245.title: Confirmatory Person-Oriented Mediation Analysis in Categorical Variables-Options and Limitations
pmc-13457245.creator: Alexander von Eye, Wolfgang Wiedermann
pmc-13457245.description: In this article, we propose three new approaches to analyzing person-oriented mediation hypotheses. First, we propose using relevance logic instead of classical logic. Relevance logic (1) rejects the ex falso sequitur quodlibet (“from a falsehood anything follows”) rule and (2) requires that the premise and the outcome of an implication exhibit variable sharing, that is, possess a substantive link.
